title: No-Charge Lines and the Supply Date of an Item, PAP Supply Replenishment Program
content:
**Rule.** For a refill request in the PAP Supply Replenishment Program, no-charge lines count toward an item's supply as follows:

1. when the enrollment shows a no-charge reship for wrong item or carrier lost, an item's no-charge lines count at their own covered-through date;
2. when it shows only no-charge replacements for manufacturer defect or mask-fit exchange, an item's latest no-charge line counts at the covered-through date of the line it replaced.

An item's supply runs out on the latest of the dates that count toward it. An enrollment with no no-charge replacement at all gains nothing under this rule.

## Reading the enrollment

The test looks at all of the enrollment's no-charge replacements, of any item and any date:

| No-charge replacements on the enrollment | How an item's no-charge lines count |
|---|---|
| at least one for wrong item or carrier lost (with or without others) | each no-charge line of the item counts at its own covered-through date; the latest of them is the one that matters |
| only for manufacturer defect or mask-fit exchange | the item's latest no-charge line (by ship date) counts at the covered-through date of the line it replaced |
| none | nothing to count |

## Cases (hypothetical)

- The enrollment shows a carrier-lost reship of filters. A nasal cushion also has a no-charge line covering through 20 July, and its latest coverage-billed line covers through 10 July. The cushion's supply runs out on 20 July, the later of the two.
- The enrollment shows only a manufacturer-defect replacement of headgear, sent with a covered-through date of 15 September and replacing a line that covered through 1 August. Headgear's latest coverage-billed line covers through 1 August; the no-charge line counts at 1 August, so the supply runs out on 1 August.
- Same enrollment, but a later coverage-billed headgear line covers through 30 October: the supply runs out on 30 October, the latest date that counts.
